```{=html}
<style>
.shape-item {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-start;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  vertical-align: top;
  box-sizing: content-box;
  min-width: 9rem;
  margin: 0.75rem;
  text-align: center;
}
.shape-name {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  word-break: break-all;
}
</style>
```

## Fill & Stroke

These are not separate shapes — they show the `fill=` and `stroke=` attributes (any CSS color) plus the `.shape-stroke-*` width classes applied to any shape above.

::::: {.shape-item}
::: {.shape-circle fill="none" stroke="#3498db" .shape-stroke-lg .shape-md}
:::
[`.shape-circle`]{.shape-name}
:::::
::::: {.shape-item}
::: {.shape-star fill="#e74c3c" stroke="#111111" .shape-stroke-md .shape-md}
:::
[`.shape-star`]{.shape-name}
:::::
::::: {.shape-item}
::: {.shape-cube fill="#3498db" stroke="#111111" .shape-stroke-md .shape-md}
:::
[`.shape-cube`]{.shape-name}
:::::

## Sizes

Also a modifier, not a shape group — the `.shape-{sm,md,lg}` classes set the shape's bounding box. `.shape-full` fills its container.

::::: {.shape-item}
::: {.shape-circle fill="#3498db" .shape-sm}
:::
[`.shape-circle`]{.shape-name}
:::::
::::: {.shape-item}
::: {.shape-circle fill="#2ecc71" .shape-md}
:::
[`.shape-circle`]{.shape-name}
:::::
::::: {.shape-item}
::: {.shape-circle fill="#e74c3c" .shape-lg}
:::
[`.shape-circle`]{.shape-name}
:::::

For a custom size, use the `size=` attribute with any length — it overrides the size classes.

::::: {.shape-item}
::: {.shape-circle fill="#9b59b6" size="2cm"}
:::
[`.shape-circle`]{.shape-name}
:::::
::::: {.shape-item}
::: {.shape-circle fill="#1abc9c" size="4cm"}
:::
[`.shape-circle`]{.shape-name}
:::::

## Rotation

Also a modifier, not a shape group — the `.shape-rotate-*` classes turn any shape in 45° steps.

::::: {.shape-item}
::: {.shape-triangle fill="#9b59b6" .shape-rotate-180 .shape-md}
:::
[`.shape-triangle`]{.shape-name}
:::::
::::: {.shape-item}
::: {.shape-arrow fill="#3498db" .shape-rotate-90 .shape-md}
:::
[`.shape-arrow`]{.shape-name}
:::::
::::: {.shape-item}
::: {.shape-moon fill="#f1c40f" .shape-rotate-270 .shape-md}
:::
[`.shape-moon`]{.shape-name}
:::::
